contributing_factors.name: Inadequate Student Supervision
contributing_factors.description: Insufficient monitoring of students in classrooms, labs, hostels, or common areas

contributing_factors.name: Policy Non-Compliance
contributing_factors.description: Failure by students, faculty, or staff to follow institute rules and code of conduct

contributing_factors.name: Facility or Infrastructure Hazard
contributing_factors.description: Unsafe physical conditions such as broken equipment, poor lighting, or structural issues

contributing_factors.name: Academic Pressure or Stress
contributing_factors.description: Excessive academic demands, examination stress, or competitive environment

contributing_factors.name: Lack of Awareness or Training
contributing_factors.description: Insufficient orientation, safety training, or awareness programs for students or staff

contributing_factors.name: Peer Influence
contributing_factors.description: Negative influence from peer groups leading to misconduct or unsafe behavior

contributing_factors.name: Poor Communication
contributing_factors.description: Miscommunication between students, faculty, administration, or parents

contributing_factors.name: Mental Health or Wellbeing Factor
contributing_factors.description: Underlying mental health challenges, personal issues, or emotional distress

contributing_factors.name: System or IT Failure
contributing_factors.description: Technical failures in academic portals, exam systems, or campus IT infrastructure

contributing_factors.name: Environmental or External Factor
contributing_factors.description: Weather, off-campus events, or external circumstances contributing to the incident
